messages.subject: CPD: 'W&I insurance in mid-market M&A' — 5 March, lunch & learn
messages.plaintextBody:
Hello all,

We're hosting a CPD lunch & learn on warranty & indemnity insurance in mid-market deals on 5 March, 12:30 in the Bishopsgate room. One CPD hour. Sandwiches provided. Please reply to me if attending so I can confirm numbers.

Donna
